basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Junior Resident (MBBS) posts at Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital is on 17 November 2026 (Tuesday) at 10:00 a.m., in the Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053; the application form is given out only between 9 AM and 10:00 AM that day. The hospital, under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, is filling 2 posts of Junior Resident Doctors on adhoc basis, with pay of Rs.56100 – 177500 of Level 10 plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

content_sections.heading: About the Hospital
content_sections.text: Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital (JPCH) is a hospital of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of NCT of Delhi, located at Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053. The hospital can be reached on 011-22184453 and 011-22568802 (Fax 011-2184455) and by email at [email protected] . The walk-in notice is signed by Dr. Yogesh Kr. Gupta, I/C Residents, and is dated 13 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: JPCH has advertised 2 posts of Junior Resident (MBBS) . Both posts are in the UR category; no post is shown against SC, ST, OBC or EWS. One post is reserved for a Physically Handicapped person as horizontal reservation. The notice states that the number of vacancies is provisional and subject to change without any notice, and that the number of vacant posts may vary. MBBS degree from a recognized University. Valid registration with Delhi Medical Council. The candidate should have completed compulsory rotating internship after 16.11.2024. The candidate must not have completed one year Junior Residency in any recognized institution, including regular and adhoc period. In case fresh candidates are not available, candidates who have completed 01 year of Junior Residency may also be allowed to appear in the interview. The age limit for Junior Residents is 30 years for General Candidates, counted on the closing date of submission of application. The notice does not mention the age limit or any relaxation for other categories. The notice does not list the individual allowances; it says only that allowances are paid as admissible under the rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs.56100 – 177500 of Level 10 plus allowances as admissible under the rules

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original certificates and testimonials. Self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials, to be attached with the application form. Two passport size photographs (one passport size photograph is to be submitted with the application form). Valid DMC (Delhi Medical Council) registration certificate and internship completion certificate, which are verified before appointment.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Collect the application form from the Administration Branch of the hospital between 9 AM and 10:00 AM on 17 November 2026. Fill in the application form and attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials and one passport size photograph. Report to the Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, with all original certificates and testimonials. Submit the filled application form at the time of interview. Appear in the interview, which starts at 10:00 a.m. Selection is through interview only. If the number of applications is very high, the interview may be continued on the next working days. Board Members will tell candidates this verbally at the closing time on the date of interview, and no separate communication will be made. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When is the JPCH Junior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026 (Tuesday) at 10:00 a.m., and it may continue on the next working days if applications are very high.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the JPCH walk-in interview venue and what time should I reach?
faq.answer: The venue is the Administrative Block (5th Floor), Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital, Shastri Park, Delhi - 110053; the application form is available only from 9 AM to 10:00 AM on the interview day.

faq.question: Q3. How many Junior Resident vacancies are there at JPCH?
faq.answer: There are 02 Junior Resident (MBBS) posts, both UR, with one post horizontally reserved for a Physically Handicapped person; the number is provisional and may vary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the JPCH Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: An MBBS degree from a recognized University, valid registration with Delhi Medical Council and compulsory rotating internship completed after 16.11.2024 are required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JPCH Junior Residents?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years for General Candidates on the closing date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Junior Resident at JPCH?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.56100 – 177500 of Level 10.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the Level 10 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the pay is Rs.56100 – 177500 of Level 10 plus allowances as admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the JPCH walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring all original certificates and testimonials, self-attested copies to attach with the application form, and two passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. How will JPCH select Junior Residents?
faq.answer: Selection will be through interview only, followed by a medical fitness check by the medical board of JPCH for selected candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JPCH Junior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely adhoc for 89 days, extendable to a maximum of 01 year including previous experience, or till the regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier.
